response.sql: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_mean FROM patient_stats) SELECT ps.SEX, AVG(ps.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(ps.avg_diff) AS avg_iga_minus_igm, AVG(ps.avg_diff / o.overall_mean) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_stats ps CROSS JOIN overall o GROUP BY ps.SEX
